content:
hana: Heads-up from tsubame-v2 int8 onboarding: noticeable quality regression on vertical CJK + ruby (furigana) samples after QAT->int8. Quick numbers: fp16 BLEU=30.6 -> tsubame-int8 BLEU=26.9 on our vertical_ruby_eval split. Also seeing a few cases where punctuation moves to wrong side around short Arabic annotations in mixed docs.

samir: can you paste the eval command and one minimal failing pair?

hana: ran with: 
```
python tools/eval_translate.py \
  --model=tsubame-v2:quant=int8 \
  --testset=data/vertical_ruby_mixed_orient.jsonl \
  --metrics=bleu,chrf --batch=32
```
raw: tsubame-int8 BLEU=26.9 chrF=42.1 | baseline-fp16 BLEU=30.6 chrF=47.8. qa-bot: diff BLEU=-3.7 (stat sig).

li: show minimal example + detok output? tokenization drift vs LM scoring?

hana: minimal example: 
src: "     例の記録　ルビーナ(有)》"
ref: "例の記録　ルビーナ(有)」参考"
ts-int8: "例の記録　ルビーナ(有)》"
issue: closing ruby bracket in output is wrong glyph (looks like fullwidth close-angle) and trailing fragment missing in some cases; sometimes furigana alignment is dropped.

samir: sounds like a detok ordering/regression. Did tokenizer map change?
hana: token_map stayed the same (token_map_v3.json). suspect runtime detok merge + kv-cache prefix trimming interacting badly with vertical-ruby anchor rules. The runtime attempted an aggressive punctuation coalescing to reduce token count in int8 path.

li: I'll grep for ruby/kanji punctuation special-cases and check whether bidi/reordering runs before or after detok merge. If merge is post-bidi it could move punctuation incorrectly.

samir: i'll spin quick variants: (1) int8 kernels + detok-merge-off, (2) int8 + older kvcache flush timing, (3) int8 + locale-aware merge (only LTR). Will report BLEU/chrF for each. ETA ~1.5h.

hana: added small human-inspect set to ci/regress/vertical_ruby_manual.jsonl (PR #3782). please include 10 samples that show ruby/bracket shifts.

qa-bot: smoke-run queued on bench-small. tsubame-int8-subset BLEU=27.2 -> baseline-subset BLEU=30.8.

li: if detok-merge proves to blame, short-term fix: disable merge for vertical/oriented layouts and add a test to prevent regressions. Longer-term: make merge aware of grapheme clusters and ruby anchors.

hana: agreed. marking this P1 for onboarding (escalate to P0 if any production models show similar drop). keep updates here. :mag: 

(END)
